portal_card.heading: Permit / Inspection Lookup
portal_card.instruction: Select your Florida county and municipality below to navigate directly to official permit records, inspection requests, and plan review status.

guidance_cards.title: Have Your Permit # Ready
guidance_cards.description: Florida building portals allow instant lookups using your permit number, folios/parcel ID, or site physical address.

guidance_cards.title: Schedule Inspections
guidance_cards.description: Most Florida jurisdictions cut off next-day inspection requests at 3:30 PM - 4:00 PM. Have your 3-digit inspection code ready.

guidance_cards.title: Licensed Contractor Oversight
guidance_cards.description: Just Smart Choice Construction USA holds Florida Certified General Contractor License #CGC1534063 for all permitted work.

support_box.title: Need Help Finding Your Permit Record?
